# polaris_catalog_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a Polaris catalog role to a principal role, granting catalog-level permissions to principals holding that principal role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_catalog_role_assignment" "engineers_catalog_admin" {
  principal_role_name = polaris_principal_role.data_engineers.name
  catalog_name        = polaris_catalog.analytics.name
  catalog_role_name   = polaris_catalog_role.catalog_admin.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_name` (String) The catalog containing the role.
- `catalog_role_name` (String) The name of the catalog role to assign.
- `principal_role_name` (String) The name of the principal role receiving the catalog role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite identifier of the assignment in format `principal_role_name/catalog_name/catalog_role_name`.
